Trimmed by hand from manual-case-assert-stack-full.txt (untrimmed ModLoad/NatVis noise
removed; frame Args-to-Child columns replaced with `...` since they are stack garbage, not
evidence). manual-case-assert-stack-full.txt is generated by get_stack.py (committed
alongside both), which passes the argv list directly to subprocess.run, resolves the compiler
path relative to the repository root rather than hardcoding it, and pipes the captured text
through triage.py's own `redact_paths` before writing -- re-run it to reproduce the full
capture and diff against this trimmed copy.
`sxe -c "kb 12; gh" e0000001; g; q` breaks on the C++-exception-style assert (0xE0000001),
prints a 12-frame stack, then `gh` ("go handled") lets execution continue as NDEBUG would.
